logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-05 verification memo. A single-column proportional bar chart of measured energy per common charging acceptance test: P2 15 kWh, P3 24 kWh, P1 44 kWh, P4 64 kWh, drawn on a stated scale (4 px per kWh) with a 0-70 kWh axis and gridlines every 10 kWh. P2 highlighted as leader; P4 flagged as the defect boundary case (5/5, zero margin). A small side panel restates the gate check: quality >=80 passes 4/4, defects <=5 passes 4/4, winner P2 with leader gaps 9/29/49 kWh. No decorative elements; every label serves the client's lowest-energy selection decision.
